provenance.paper_title: Semantic and Visual Evidence for Efficient Long-Video Reasoning: A Solution for the HD-EPIC VQA Challenge

representation_paths.memory_component: selected semantic and visual evidence relevant to each question

evidence.paraphrase: Evidence representations (text-form semantic cues + visual frame cues) selected per question. question-conditioned evidence selection balances semantic and visual signals.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): The full-paper lifecycle review found selected semantic and visual evidence relevant to each question fixed during downstream inference; query-conditioned access, preprocessing, or training-time changes were not counted as persistent deployed updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
